meta.name: Black Doves
meta.description: When a spy posing as a politician's wife learns her lover has been murdered, an old assassin friend joins her on a quest for truth — and vengeance.

videos.title: To Love Then
videos.overview: When politician's wife and undercover spy Helen Webb learns that her lover has been murdered, the Black Doves recruit an old friend to help protect her.

videos.title: A Little Black Dove
videos.overview: After reaching a dead end in the search for Jason's killer, Helen has to fight for her own life, while Sam receives a threat from his former employer.

videos.title: The Coming Night
videos.overview: Memories of Sam's past come back to haunt him as he prepares to finish the job he started seven years ago. Wallace secretly meets with a Chinese envoy.

videos.title: Go Bang Time
videos.overview: Investigations into the ambassador's death reach the highest corridors of power. Helen pays a risky visit to an old friend, and Sam faces a tough choice.

videos.title: The Cost of It All
videos.overview: With danger drawing closer, Sam takes refuge in the only safe place he knows. Reed issues an ultimatum, and Helen gets one step closer to the truth.

videos.title: In the Bleak Midwinter
videos.overview: Armed with evidence and bent on vengeance, Helen goes searching for the Clarks. As the conspiracy starts to unravel, she has a deadly decision to make.

videos.title: Black Door
videos.overview: As her husband steps up as prime minister, Helen helps Reed steal files codenamed Wildflower and a shadowy organization coerces Sam into a contract.

videos.title: Put Your Head on My Shoulder
videos.overview: Helen realizes her investigation into Reed's mysterious past connects to Sam's new targets — just after he silences their best hope for answers.

videos.title: P Is for Poison
videos.overview: Sam grapples with the fallout of a desperate choice. Helen presses an old foe for answers on Reed and Wildflower before a tense dinner with the Chernovs.

videos.title: The Opportunity to Become Savage
videos.overview: East Berlin, 1988. Reed's cover in Kestrel is blown when a botched mission forces an unforgivable choice — and its deadly aftermath reaches into the present.

videos.title: Murder Mix
videos.overview: Helen recruits Sam, Williams and Eleanor to extract a high profile target from a secure site, but Kestrel's influence threatens the mission.

videos.title: Peace Summit
videos.overview: Kestrel enacts its plan ahead of Wallace's peace summit — forcing Sam to decide where his loyalties lie, and pushing Helen to admit a dangerous truth.
